title: Shichuu Suimei Pitagraph (Japan): pause check
summary: Move the upstream guarded pause-status edit into a disc-sector recipe.
rationale: The exact first-read A.BIN contains the 600C8801 preimage required by the inherited menu callback. This preserves its one-byte change from waiting while PAUSE (1) to waiting while BUSY (0). The actual callback and early overlay match all 121 video/audio checkpoints and full PCM in the native-drive emulator; both remain in a BUSY wait there. That native-drive stall is not a migration difference and is not claimed fixed. SAROO MCU/FPGA timing and physical game compatibility remain unqualified.

writes.effect: Change the CMP/EQ immediate at 0601CFD6 from 1 to 0.
writes.reason: Retain the upstream workaround for a PAUSE-status loop using a guarded read overlay.
